Read one component of a complete geometry

Source: R/result.R
geometry_component.Rd

geometry_component() returns the packed geometry rows themselves, for the cases where a view is not enough. Reach for it only after materialize_geometry(); a query-only result from evaluate_geometry() has no stored component to read.

Usage

geometry_component(x, component = "total", rows = NULL)

Arguments

x

A complete effect_form (including an effect_geometry).

component

One of total, coherent, or configuration. configuration is computed exactly as total - coherent.

rows

Optional measurement rows to read. Block-backed stores read only the requested rows.

Value

A numeric matrix with one row per measurement and one column per packed geometry coordinate (svec order for symmetric self forms: the lower triangle by column, off-diagonal entries scaled by sqrt(2)).

See also

query_geometry() to apply a linear query instead of reading packed coordinates, and rdm() or contrast_energy() for the named scientific views.

Other geometry plans and views: aggregate_first(), bilinear_query(), coherence_spectrum(), compute_policy(), contrast_energy(), contribution(), crossnobis(), evaluate_geometry(), example_fmri_effects(), geometry_spectrum(), latent_geometry(), materialize_geometry(), plan_crossnobis(), plan_geometry(), plot_views, query_geometry(), rdm(), rsa(), variation_query()

Examples

domain <- abstract_domain(4, id = "component-example")
relation <- relation(
  list(run1 = rbind(a = c(1, 0, 2, 1), b = c(0, 1, 1, 0)),
       run2 = rbind(a = c(1.1, 0.1, 1.9, 0.8), b = c(0.1, 0.9, 1.2, 0.2))),
  domain = domain
)
geometry <- materialize_geometry(plan_geometry(
  relation, compile_frame(regions(c("v1", "v1", "it", "it")), domain),
  cross_partitions(relation, independence = "independent")
))

# One row per region; three packed coordinates for a 2-effect self form,
# namely G[1,1], G[2,1], and G[2,2].
geometry_component(geometry, "total")
#>      [,1]       [,2] [,3]
#> [1,] 0.55 0.07071068 0.45
#> [2,] 2.30 1.59099026 0.60

# The coherent/configuration split is an exact partition, not a fit.
all.equal(
  geometry_component(geometry, "configuration"),
  geometry_component(geometry, "total") -
    geometry_component(geometry, "coherent")
)
#> [1] TRUE

# Read a single measurement without touching the rest.
geometry_component(geometry, "total", rows = 2)
#>      [,1]    [,2] [,3]
#> [1,]  2.3 1.59099  0.6
